bindings.rationale: Archive nesting is a bundle-packager responsibility. The runtime treats the supplied directory as the bundle root and requires config.json directly beneath it.
The conventional rootfs basename is bundle-author guidance. The runtime accepts that name and preserves every other valid POSIX root path without rewriting it.

Annotation naming and use of reserved keys are configuration-author responsibilities. The runtime validates known standard values and preserves other non-empty keys as required by the separate extensibility contract.

Image-to-runtime conversion provenance is owned by the converter and is not observable at runtime. The SDK pins the referenced conversion document, validates the resulting standard values, and preserves them exactly.
The OCI kill operation carries an explicit signal, so default stop orchestration belongs to the runtime caller. The SDK exposes the validated annotation as a portable Linux signal for that caller.
Reservation of future org.opencontainers keys constrains subsequent specification authors. Runtime extensibility separately requires unknown keys to remain accepted and preserved.
